clientStrengths: Insightful, creative, and motivated for change
clientProtective: Supportive partner, future-oriented goals, no access to firearms
clientResources: Stable housing, employer insurance, and a primary care provider
medicalNecessityNote: Daily worry and muscle tension disrupt sleep (4–5 hours per night) and concentration at work; the client has missed 3 workdays this month.

activeGoals.broadGoal: Reduce the frequency and intensity of somatic anxiety and uncontrollable worry while expanding daily window of tolerance.
interventions: Clinician will provide psychoeducation on nervous system regulation, polyvagal states, and window of tolerance.
Clinician will guide somatic and sensory grounding exercises (e.g., 5-4-3-2-1, paced breathing, TIPP skills) in session.

objectives.text: Within 90 days, client will identify 3 personal somatic/cognitive early warning signs of escalating anxiety and utilize 1 grounding or breathwork skill at least 4 times per week when anxiety exceeds 6/10.

smartParts.relevantNeed: to improve daily regulation and functioning

objectives.text: Within 90 days, client will practice cognitive defusion or worry-time containment strategies at least 3 times per week to reduce nightly rumination from 7 nights/week to 3 or fewer nights/week.

smartParts.relevantNeed: to improve daily regulation and functioning

dischargeCriteria: The client will be ready to step down in frequency or finish therapy when active goals are consistently met, symptoms stay manageable for 8 or more consecutive weeks, and the client uses coping strategies independently.
clientParticipationNote: This plan was developed with the client during session. The client expressed understanding of and agreement with the goals, objectives, and interventions.
